lessons.title: Let’s Order!

items.exampleMeaning: I want a cup of coffee.
I always drink tea in the morning.
Can I have some water, please?
I want bread with butter.
That cake looks good.
Where is the menu?

lessons.tip: In Swedish, nouns have gender. 'Kaffe' is common gender, while 'vatten' is neuter. Remember to use the correct article: en for common and ett for neuter.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Jag vill ha en kopp kaffe.
dialogue.meaning: I want a cup of coffee.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ja, jag vill ha en kaka.

scenario.brief: Ställ en fråga om vad kunden vill ha. Ge dem menyn.
scenario.goal: You should order a drink and a snack.

lessons.title: Using Numbers!

items.exampleMeaning: I want one glass of water.
I will take two pieces of bread.
Can I have three cups of tea?
We want four cakes.
It costs five kronor.
I have ten kronor.

lessons.tip: Swedish numbers can be tricky. Practice counting from one to ten, as they are often used in daily conversations.

scenario.brief: Fråga kunden hur många de vill ha av något. Räkna upp priserna.
scenario.goal: You should order a specific number of items.

lessons.title: Polite Requests!

items.example: Kan jag få en kopp te, 'snälla'?
items.exampleMeaning: Can I have a cup of tea, please?
Thank you very much for the food!
Excuse me, where is the bathroom?
Can you give me the menu?

items.example: Jag vill ha en kopp kaffe, snälla.
items.exampleMeaning: I want a cup of coffee, please.
Can I get help?

lessons.tip: Use 'snälla' when you want to make a request polite. It shows respect and kindness.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Excuse me, what do you want?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Jag vill ha en kaka, snälla.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Vill du ha något att dricka?
dialogue.meaning: Do you want something to drink?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ja, en kopp te, tack så mycket.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, a cup of tea, thank you very much.

scenario.brief: Fråga kunden om de vill ha något mer. Var artig i din kommunikation.

lessons.title: Enjoying the Café!

items.exampleMeaning: This café is cozy.
I love the food here.
Which drink do you recommend?
We can sit by the window.
I want to taste the cake.
I want to enjoy my coffee.

lessons.tip: When describing places, 'mysig' is a great word to express coziness. It’s often used for cafés and homes.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you want to sit here?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I want to taste the cake.

scenario.brief: Fråga kunden vad de tycker om maten och om de vill sitta.
scenario.goal: You should express enjoyment of the café experience.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Jag vill ha en kopp kaffe, snälla.
dialogue.meaning: I want a cup of coffee, please.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hur många kakor vill du ha?
dialogue.meaning: How many cakes do you want?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ja, jag vill njuta av min mat här.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I want to enjoy my food here.

scenario.brief: Engage in a conversation about ordering food and drinks at the café.
scenario.goal: You should practice ordering and expressing your preferences.
